reranker_readiness.note: A logistic reranker is statistically meaningless on this corpus: 13 examples offer more than one distinct scientific AST and 18 have the right answer outside first place, against a pre-registered requirement of 50 and 20. Training here would only learn to tell a single AST from RAW.

notes: ASR-first is N/A: no record in this corpus carries an ASR hypothesis, so no failure can be attributed to recognition.

component_isolation.note: Isolated numbers are laboratory component quality, not a product improvement ceiling; they are not additive with the oracle replacement deltas.

calibration.verdict: порог нельзя выбрать по данным: ошибок среди отвеченного 1, нужно не менее 20. При таком числе ошибок любые два порога различаются в пределах шума, и «лучший» из них будет выбран случайно. Оценка приняла 2 различных значений — калибровать шкалу почти без размаха тоже нечем.

candidate_lattice.verdict: данных для логистического baseline недостаточно: 18 примеров, где золотой ответ не первый, нужно не менее 50. Это предварительный порог протокола, не теорема об обобщении.

notes: This is a text-level development corpus. There are no real voices in it, and ASR accuracy is not measured here.
pre_insertion_end_to_end_exact_match stops before the operating-system insertion step. The Word COM path is not exercised by this harness and must not be called verified.
The confidence produced by sciwhisper-core is a deterministic parse level, not a calibrated probability. No metric here treats it as one.
Oracle replacement deltas answer the product question and are not additive; component isolation answers the laboratory question and is a different quantity.
An observed count of zero for a rare safety error is reported with its exact one-sided 95% upper bound, never as a proven zero.

The insert/abstain threshold is reported as a risk–coverage curve rather than defended. `no_worse_than_configured` lists only thresholds that give up nothing on coverage, accuracy and risk at once; a trade between them is the owner's decision.

The candidate lattice offers readings; it never inserts one. Readings that exist only because the words were edited first are generated behind RAW, so a wider lattice cannot raise the false-rewrite rate on its own.
